integratedFlow: exact surviving selection rebind or safe clear

advancedEditBoundaries.tie: requires exactly two explicit revision-bound note endpoints
advancedEditBoundaries.slur: requires exactly two explicit revision-bound note endpoints
advancedEditBoundaries.triplet: requires exactly three consecutive revision-bound EVENT_RANGE addresses in one exact measure voice with canonical timing evidence
advancedEditBoundaries.tripletRetimingRemoval: not implemented when canonical onset/duration retiming would be required; fail closed
advancedEditBoundaries.ambiguousOrUnsupportedEvidence: fail closed; never infer nearest endpoints or ranges

currentRevisionRules.qualityEvidence: source quality report is not silently cloned onto corrected revisions
currentRevisionRules.routing: Guitar TAB and Violin routes are recomputed for the current revision and remain REVIEW/BLOCK when evidence does not justify PASS
currentRevisionRules.playback: playback authority is independent of renderer/editor readiness and follows its own playback policy
currentRevisionRules.rendererRecovery: uses the current revalidated product MusicXML when available; does not rerun OMR; exact highlight is rebound only if the current selection survives
